summary: A standard mapping between Stellar's XDR structures and a JSON representation.

sections.title: XDR Data Types
sections.content: Mapping of the RFC 4506 data types to JSON

xdr_json_features.name: integer_32bit
xdr_json_features.description: 32-bit signed integer maps to a JSON number

xdr_json_features.name: unsigned_integer_32bit
xdr_json_features.description: 32-bit unsigned integer maps to a JSON number

xdr_json_features.name: hyper_integer_64bit
xdr_json_features.description: 64-bit signed integer maps to a JSON string holding a base-10 integer

xdr_json_features.name: unsigned_hyper_integer_64bit
xdr_json_features.description: 64-bit unsigned integer maps to a JSON string holding a base-10 integer

xdr_json_features.name: boolean
xdr_json_features.description: Boolean maps to a JSON boolean

xdr_json_features.name: opaque_fixed_length
xdr_json_features.description: Fixed-length opaque data maps to a hexadecimal string of the declared width

xdr_json_features.name: opaque_variable_length
xdr_json_features.description: Variable-length opaque data maps to a hexadecimal string

xdr_json_features.name: string_escape_ladder
xdr_json_features.description: String bytes escape nul, tab, line feed, carriage return and backslash by name, keep printable ASCII verbatim, and write every other byte as \xNN

xdr_json_features.name: string_json_escaping
xdr_json_features.description: Backslashes in an escaped string are escaped a second time when stored in JSON

xdr_json_features.name: array_fixed_length
xdr_json_features.description: Fixed-length array maps to a JSON array of the declared element count

xdr_json_features.name: array_variable_length
xdr_json_features.description: Variable-length array maps to a JSON array

xdr_json_features.name: enum_name_mapping
xdr_json_features.description: Enum maps to a JSON string: the identifier in snake_case with any shared prefix removed

xdr_json_features.name: struct_object_keys
xdr_json_features.description: Struct maps to a JSON object keyed by the member names in snake_case

xdr_json_features.name: union_void_arm
xdr_json_features.description: A union whose active arm is void maps to a JSON string holding the arm name

xdr_json_features.name: union_valued_arm
xdr_json_features.description: A union whose active arm carries a value maps to a single-key JSON object

xdr_json_features.name: union_integer_cases
xdr_json_features.description: A union switching on an integer names its arms by discriminant plus integer, such as v0

xdr_json_features.name: void
xdr_json_features.description: Void carries no JSON value of its own; the object form of a void arm is rejected

xdr_json_features.name: optional_null
xdr_json_features.description: An absent optional maps to null and its key stays present in the parent object

sections.title: Address Types
sections.content: Stellar address, signer and key types rendered as SEP-23 strkeys

xdr_json_features.name: sc_address
xdr_json_features.description: ScAddress maps to a G, C, M, B or L strkey according to its arm

xdr_json_features.name: account_id
xdr_json_features.description: AccountID maps to a G strkey

xdr_json_features.name: contract_id
xdr_json_features.description: ContractID maps to a C strkey

xdr_json_features.name: muxed_account
xdr_json_features.description: MuxedAccount maps to a G strkey for ed25519 and an M strkey for muxed ed25519

xdr_json_features.name: muxed_account_med25519
xdr_json_features.description: MuxedAccountMed25519 maps to an M strkey

xdr_json_features.name: muxed_ed25519_account
xdr_json_features.description: MuxedEd25519Account maps to an M strkey

xdr_json_features.name: pool_id
xdr_json_features.description: PoolID maps to an L strkey

xdr_json_features.name: claimable_balance_id
xdr_json_features.description: ClaimableBalanceID maps to a B strkey

xdr_json_features.name: public_key
xdr_json_features.description: PublicKey maps to a G strkey

xdr_json_features.name: node_id
xdr_json_features.description: NodeID maps to a G strkey

xdr_json_features.name: signer_key
xdr_json_features.description: SignerKey maps to a G, T, X or P strkey according to its arm

xdr_json_features.name: signer_key_ed25519_signed_payload
xdr_json_features.description: SignerKeyEd25519SignedPayload maps to a P strkey

sections.title: Asset Code Types
sections.content: Asset code types rendered as trimmed, escaped strings

xdr_json_features.name: asset_code
xdr_json_features.description: AssetCode reads back as AssetCode4 at four encoded characters or fewer, otherwise AssetCode12

xdr_json_features.name: asset_code4
xdr_json_features.description: AssetCode4 drops all trailing zero bytes, then escapes the remaining bytes as a string

xdr_json_features.name: asset_code12
xdr_json_features.description: AssetCode12 drops trailing zero bytes down to a floor of five, then escapes the remaining bytes

sections.title: Integer Types
sections.content: 128-bit and 256-bit integer parts rendered as a single base-10 string

xdr_json_features.name: uint128_parts
xdr_json_features.description: UInt128Parts maps to a JSON string holding the 128-bit unsigned value in base 10

xdr_json_features.name: int128_parts
xdr_json_features.description: Int128Parts maps to a JSON string holding the 128-bit signed value in base 10

xdr_json_features.name: uint256_parts
xdr_json_features.description: UInt256Parts maps to a JSON string holding the 256-bit unsigned value in base 10

xdr_json_features.name: int256_parts
xdr_json_features.description: Int256Parts maps to a JSON string holding the 256-bit signed value in base 10

sections.title: JSON Schema
sections.content: The optional $schema property the specification allows on any object

xdr_json_features.name: schema_property
xdr_json_features.description: A $schema property is allowed but not required on any JSON object

sections.title: XDR-JSON v1 Compatibility
sections.content: Allowances the specification makes for reading XDR-JSON version 1 documents

xdr_json_features.name: hyper_json_number_input
xdr_json_features.description: A JSON number is accepted where a Hyper is read; output stays a string

xdr_json_features.name: unsigned_hyper_json_number_input
xdr_json_features.description: A JSON number is accepted where an Unsigned Hyper is read; output stays a string

sections.title: Implementation Support
sections.content: The conversion surface an SDK exposes for XDR-JSON

xdr_json_features.name: to_xdr_json
xdr_json_features.description: Convert an XDR value to XDR-JSON text

xdr_json_features.name: to_xdr_json_value
xdr_json_features.description: Convert an XDR value to an XDR-JSON tree

xdr_json_features.name: from_xdr_json
xdr_json_features.description: Read an XDR value from XDR-JSON text

xdr_json_features.name: from_xdr_json_value
xdr_json_features.description: Read an XDR value from an XDR-JSON tree

xdr_json_features.name: from_xdr_json_tree
xdr_json_features.description: Read an XDR value from a tree built by hand, with container nesting bounded

xdr_json_features.name: typedef_codec_namespace
xdr_json_features.description: XDR types a typedef collapses onto another Swift type keep their own conversion entry points

xdr_json_features.name: xdr_type_conversions
xdr_json_features.description: Every XDR type in the SDK has an XDR-JSON conversion
